name: Sidebar
description: Vertical app navigation with grouped links, a current page, and optional counts.

props.name: sections
props.type: { label?: string; items: { label: string; href: string; icon?: ReactNode; badge?: string | number; current?: boolean }[] }[]
props.description: Groups of links. Mark the page the user is on with current.

props.name: header
props.description: Content above the links, such as a logo or workspace switcher.

props.name: footer
props.description: Content pinned below the links, such as the signed-in user.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the navigation landmark.

a11y: Renders a <nav> landmark with an accessible name.
The current page link has aria-current="page" and a non-color indicator.
Section labels are headings or labelled lists so screen readers announce the groups.
Every item is a real link reachable with Tab, with a visible focus style.
